name: Probabilistic analysis
blurb: Monte Carlo as-built variations of an HR Steel (IS 800) design — E, plate thickness, storey out-of-plumb drawn from the published surveys (information, not a design basis) — re-analysed with the design's own IS 800 model and load_plan combinations and checked against its own IS 800 design strengths (γm from Table 5 taken out or kept). Where would you take a second look?

tabs.title: Probabilistic
tabs.blurb: Load this project's HR Steel (IS 800) design (or any package), choose the number of as-built variations (default 100), run, and read the distribution of the maximum member and connection D/C against the design's own values (kN, mm; IS 1893 storey drift against 0.004 h). Runs in the Nonlinear (SNL-IN) module's environment; nothing is recomputed on the capacity side.
